prompts.title: Repo status and next safe checks
prompts.instruction: Inspect the current repository state and propose a small set of safe commands to understand branch, dirty files, recent commits, and obvious verification checks. Do not modify files.

prompts.title: Test/lint/build triage
prompts.instruction: Given the working directory context, propose safe test, lint, or build commands that would verify the project with minimal blast radius. Prefer package-manager scripts when visible from context; otherwise propose common diagnostics only.

prompts.title: Windows workstation health snapshot
prompts.instruction: Propose read-only PowerShell commands to inspect processes, services, disk, and basic workstation health. Do not change services, registry, Defender, firewall, scheduled tasks, or startup settings.

prompts.title: Dev-lab situation brief
prompts.instruction: Propose a concise read-only command set that helps summarize current dev-lab state from this directory: repo status, recent commits, likely project type, and next verification gate.
